newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian Energy up on sluggish bourse.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian Energy up on sluggish bourse.

text.p: Lithuanian shares led by Lithuanian Energy edged up on Tuesday but volume remained low on the country's sluggish bourse, dealers said.
The group A index, which tracks the most active listings, rose by 19.35 points to 2,414 in trade of 1.2 million litas.
Lithuanian Energy led the way, advancing 7.14 percent to 3.00 litas in trade of over 352,000 litas.
"Lithuanian Energy's shares have benefited from talk of privatization in the sector," said one dealer.
The state owns a majority in the company but the government has committed itself to privatizing most of the energy sector.
The Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company also gained, rising to 7.00 litas from 6.79 litas in trade of 23,667 litas.
Dealers expect more activity after a spate of shareholders' meetings this month.
"Most foreign investors have already acquired their positions and they are holding on until they see all of the 1996 results," one dealer said.
Block trades worth over three million litas were also made.
